⭐ A Hidden Gem in Đà Lạt – Outstanding Food & Service!
Aug 2026 • Couples
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

What a wonderful dining experience! From the moment we arrived, the service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. A special thank you to Gia Hân, who looked after us so well with a friendly smile and excellent service.

The food was outstanding. The steak was cooked perfectly, tender and full of flavor. The seafood pasta was fresh and delicious, the mushroom soup was rich and creamy, and every side dish was beautifully prepared. Even the garlic bread was warm and fresh.

The restaurant itself has a beautiful atmosphere with a lovely view over Đà Lạt, making it the perfect place for a relaxing lunch or dinner.

As a travel agent with over 30 years in the travel industry, I visit many restaurants around the world, and this is definitely one I would happily recommend to my clients visiting Đà Lạt.

Thank you to the entire team for such an enjoyable experience. We will definitely be back!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly recommended!
